"""Read-only TRY index, parser, morphing, and weather-grid helpers.

Ports MATLAB lines 2951-3071 and 4296-4696.  No TRY path is implicit.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from math import floor, isfinite, isnan
from pathlib import Path
import re
from typing import Iterable, Mapping, Sequence


def _matlab_round(value: float) -> int:
    """Return MATLAB ``round`` semantics (half values away from zero)."""
    value = float(value)
    if not isfinite(value):
        raise ValueError("MATLAB-compatible rounding requires a finite value.")
    magnitude = floor(abs(value) + 0.5)
    return int(magnitude if value >= 0 else -magnitude)
